description.value: ChongQing is a long-established Szechuan Chinese restaurant that has been serving Vancouver for over twenty years across four locations. The Commercial Drive outpost sits on one of the city's most popular cycling corridors, making it a convenient stop for riders exploring East Vancouver. The menu leans into Szechuanese flavours with dishes like Honey Garlic Sliced Pork and Noodle Soup with Mixed Meat & Seafood, available for both takeout and delivery.
